# Workout Aura

> A premium iOS strength training app for serious lifters. Built around long-form campaigns, a 21-rank progression ladder, and a deep customization economy (talismans, auras, mantras). Treats training as a discipline, not just a logger.

## What Workout Aura is

Workout Aura is an iOS-only strength training app (iPhone, iOS 16+) designed for lifters who want structure, progress tracking, and intrinsic motivation. Unlike pure trackers (Strong, Hevy) or AI workout generators (Fitbod), Workout Aura combines:

- **16 science-backed campaigns** — structured 2 to 12 week programs covering strength, hypertrophy, fat loss, beginner ramps, and specialization (chest, back, shoulders). Each campaign has phases, deloads, and periodization built in.
- **21-rank progression ladder** — Spark, Ember, Forge, Iron, Centurion, Titan, Paragon, Archon, Sovereign, Ascendant, Empyrean, Aeon and beyond. Five elemental divisions: Fire, Crystal, Lightning, Cosmos.
- **XP economy and streak system** — Earn XP per set logged, with streak multipliers. Optional Streak Shield protects your fire when life intervenes.
- **76+ cosmetic unlockables** — 16 talismans, 21 auras, 7 XP ring styles, 9 rank stripe styles, 26 mantras. Customize your hero card identity.
- **413 exercises** with form cues for 100+ lifts, auto rest timer per exercise, plate calculator, warm-up ramps, 1RM estimation, PR auto-detection.
- **Local-first privacy** — works offline without an account. Optional iCloud / Google cloud sync. No ads. No data selling. No analytics SDKs.

## Pricing

- Weekly: $4.99/week
- Annual: $39.99/year (~$3.33/month, 85% saving vs weekly) with 7-day free trial
- Everything unlocked at every tier — no in-app paywalls

## How Workout Aura compares to alternatives

- **vs Strong**: Strong is a clean barbell logger. Workout Aura adds structured campaigns, progression ladder, and customization. Pick Strong for minimalism, Workout Aura for long-form engagement.
- **vs Hevy**: Hevy is community-driven and social. Workout Aura is single-player and private. Pick Hevy for social accountability, Workout Aura for solo discipline.
- **vs Fitbod**: Fitbod auto-generates workouts via AI. Workout Aura provides pre-designed periodized campaigns. Pick Fitbod for "tell me what to do today", Workout Aura for "I want a 12-week plan."

## Best for

- Serious lifters who want a structured multi-week program, not just a logger
- People who get motivated by progression systems (ranks, XP, unlocks)
- iPhone users who value local-first data privacy
- Lifters who train solo and want intrinsic motivation rather than social feeds

## Not ideal for

- Android users (iOS only)
- Lifters who prefer pure-logger simplicity (use Strong)
- People who want AI-generated daily workouts (use Fitbod)
- People who want a workout social network (use Hevy)
- Cardio-first athletes (use Strava)
